content.value_statement: Incident response can lose time when teams lack clear triage, communication, and recovery structure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through severity assessment, command setup, recovery validation, and learning.
actual_capabilities: Guides severity and impact assessment for active incidents.
Defines incident command roles and communication duties.
Suggests stabilization actions such as rollback, feature flags, scaling, and traffic throttling.
Structures investigation around metrics, traces, logs, APM, and dependency mapping.
Provides recovery validation and post-incident review steps.
Describes severity levels, error budget practices, and incident metrics.
limitations: Does not connect to monitoring platforms or collect live telemetry.
Does not execute remediation commands, deployments, rollbacks, or infrastructure changes.
Requires users to supply system context, impact data, permissions, and incident constraints.
Guidance must be validated against local runbooks, compliance duties, and production safety controls.

use_cases.title: Triage a Production Outage
use_cases.description: Assess user impact, assign severity, identify immediate stabilization steps, and list missing information.

use_cases.title: Run Incident Command
use_cases.description: Organize roles, stakeholder updates, decision tracking, and recovery checks during a high-pressure incident.

use_cases.title: Improve Reliability Process
use_cases.description: Convert incident evidence into post-incident actions, monitoring improvements, and response practice changes.

prompt_templates.title: Start Incident Triage
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for a known service issue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the incident responder skill to assess severity. Context: affected service, symptoms, user impact, start time, and recent changes. Produce priorities and missing questions.

prompt_templates.title: Create Response Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate coordination during an active incident.
prompt_templates.prompt: Act as incident commander for this situation. Define roles, update cadence, stabilization options, validation checks, and stakeholder messages.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Service Degradation
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this multi-service degradation using metrics, traces, logs, dependencies, recent changes, and error budget impact. Prioritize hypotheses and safe tests.

prompt_templates.title: Run Post-Incident Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a blameless post-incident review from this timeline. Include impact, contributing factors, detection gaps, action items, owners, and follow-up checks.

output_examples.input: Checkout errors rose after a deployment and affect 20 percent of users.
output_examples.output: Severity recommendation: P1. Immediate actions: assign command roles, pause rollout, evaluate rollback, update stakeholders, and monitor checkout recovery.

output_examples.input: A database connection pool was exhausted and the service has recovered.
output_examples.output: Post-incident output includes timeline, contributing factors, detection gaps, action items, owners, and dates for follow-up validation.

output_examples.input: Several alerts fired across API latency, queue depth, and payment timeouts.
output_examples.output: Investigation plan correlates metrics, traces, logs, dependencies, and recent changes before recommending stabilization actions.

best_practices: Provide current impact, affected services, timeline, recent changes, and known constraints.
Use the output as a response guide, then validate actions against local production controls.
Record decisions, owners, timestamps, and recovery checks during the incident.
anti_patterns: Do not treat suggested fixes as permission to change production systems.
Do not skip stakeholder communication while technical investigation continues.
Do not delay service restoration while pursuing complete root cause analysis.

faq.question: Does this skill perform automated incident remediation?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured guidance and checklists. Users must execute approved operational actions themselves.

faq.question: Can it connect to PagerDuty, Grafana, or Datadog?
faq.answer: No. It can suggest what to inspect, but it does not access external tools or live telemetry.

faq.question: Is this only for SRE teams?
faq.answer: No. It also helps developers, support leads, and managers coordinate technical incidents.

faq.question: Can it help classify incident severity?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides severity assessment using user impact, business impact, service scope, and response urgency.

faq.question: Does it replace local runbooks?
faq.answer: No. Use it with local runbooks, compliance requirements, approval rules, and safety controls.

faq.question: Can it help after the incident is resolved?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports timelines, blameless review, action items, monitoring improvements, and follow-up tracking.
